summary: No new update this turn. I finished the last unread section of the captured documentation, docs/apply.md lines 44 to 80, which walks through the apply path step by step: the apply call creating a log entry on the apply channel, a non leader answering with ErrNotLeader, dispatchLogs writing locally and notifying each follower replication, the replicate routine selecting entries from the follower next index up to the leader last index while also carrying the leader commit index, and a worked example in which an AppendEntries with no entries still bumps the follower commit index. That matches the code recorded earlier, including the commit timeout re replication I documented, and it contains nothing new or contrary, so I am re submitting the unchanged draft update47.json, the last accepted file, which the controller should treat as an exact unchanged update. Nothing further is warranted with the run clock nearly exhausted, and per the run rules expiry preserves existing work without a closing call, so I make no stop declaration. Closing state: the investigation leaves source grounded findings and bounded conclusions on CFT decision formation and progress and on context and authority transitions, protective mechanism and test coverage negatives so that passing suites are not mistaken for coverage, durable corrections attached to the affected knowledge identifiers where later evidence narrowed or reframed a claim, three cases of contrary evidence surfaced against my own records including one issue the repository already acknowledges and one documentation anchor that I weakened after reading the same document's terminology, and a paused handoff listing the five findings that still await an executed witness plus the one question whose deciding material lies outside the captured snapshot.
